name: SoFi (personal & student loan refinance)
notes: Researched from public support.sofi.com articles only (no sign-in). Payments are made from the loan card on the member dashboard (Make a payment: amount, date, account, Review, Submit payment) from a linked bank account; cards are not described (bank-only). Autopay gives a 0.25% rate reduction, always pulls on the due date, can include an extra monthly amount, and must be cancelled by the calendar day before it runs (Manage Autopay > Cancel autopay); turning it off removes the discount. Personal loan principal-only payments are not available; payments go to fees, then interest, then principal. Fixed-rate borrowers can change the due date once every 12 months to a day from the 1st to the 25th. Hardship options go through the Collections Team by phone (855-456-7634), so payment_arrangement is unsupported online. The electronic-statement article found was for SoFi Invest, so paperless is left at the family default.

help.title: Making a payment
paragraphs: Log in, open the loan you want to pay and choose Make a payment. Enter the amount, the date and the bank account, choose Review, check the details and select Submit payment.
To pay the loan off, choose Estimate early payoff, enter your payoff date and select Schedule this payment. Autopay still runs on your due date even if you schedule an extra payment.
steps: Log in to your SoFi account.

help.title: Autopay
paragraphs: Autopay gives you a 0.25% interest rate reduction. To set it up, open your loan card, choose Set up next to Autopay off, pick your monthly amount (you can add an extra amount), select a bank account and confirm with Set up autopay.

To stop it, open the loan, choose Manage Autopay and then Cancel autopay. Cancel by the calendar day before the payment is scheduled, or it processes as usual. Turning autopay off removes the discount and re-amortizes the loan.

help.title: Due dates and payment application
paragraphs: Fixed-rate personal loans are first due about 30 days after funding; variable-rate loans are due on the 10th. Fixed-rate borrowers may change the due date once every 12 months to a day between the 1st and the 25th.

Payments go to any fees first, then accrued interest, then principal. Principal-only payments are not available; to put more toward principal, pay the extra on the same day as your full monthly payment.

help.title: Hardship help
paragraphs: If you are facing a hardship or need to skip payments, contact SoFi's Collections Team at 855-456-7634. They review your situation to find what options may be available.
